page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 3.1 GHz. Operating on a KVM hypervisor platform, the instance provisions 80 dedicated vCPUs paired with 768.0 GB of RAM. This provides a memory-to-core allocation of 9.6 GB per core alongside a baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps.

The hardware configuration includes zero dedicated local storage and no attached GPU accelerators. Persistent disk operations require external network-attached storage volumes accessed via the 25 Gbps network interface. The high ratio of memory per CPU core prioritizes system memory capacity over local storage speed or specialized graphical processing capabilities.

This server architecture offers resource density for memory-bound operational environments that do not require ephemeral storage. Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is suitable for enterprise relational databases, large-scale in-memory caching systems, data analytics pipelines, and memory-intensive enterprise backend deployments.
